resources.string: On demand uses only the refresh button. Daily, weekly, and monthly also run in the background when due (soon if never scanned or overdue). Wi-Fi only can delay a run on mobile data. A shade notification posts only when apps have updates. The first scan takes longer; later scans reuse recent listings and finish faster.
